### 🎥 **YouTube Titles (Choose 1 Main + 2 Alternates)**

### 📄 **YouTube Description**  

Welcome back to **The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge** with your host **Bethany Gifford**, founder of **New Era Intel** — where we help medical spas, aesthetic clinics, and wellness leaders scale smarter through AI-driven marketing and business strategy.  

In this episode, Bethany sits down with **Tal Raizer**, Nurse Practitioner and Founder of **Plasma Med Spa**, to explore how she turned her clinical background in ER and orthopedic surgery into a thriving regenerative-focused med spa built on integrity, science, and heart.  

✨ **What You’ll Learn:**  
• How Tal transitioned from hospital medicine to aesthetics and entrepreneurship  
• Why she centered her practice around plasma-based and regenerative treatments (PRP, PRF, O-Shot, P-Shot, Vampire Facelift & more)  
• What “patient-first” culture really looks like in daily operations  
• Her candid journey through marketing missteps, agency pitfalls, and community-based growth  
• How she balances being a professor, mom of two, and med spa owner — with resilience and grace  
• The lessons she’s learned about consistency, cash-flow management, and staying authentic while scaling  

💡 Whether you’re a provider opening your first med spa or an established owner looking to integrate regenerative medicine, Tal’s story is full of real-world insight, inspiration, and practical takeaways.  

🎧 **Watch, subscribe, and share** this episode with fellow entrepreneurs and aesthetic professionals building their next chapter with purpose.
